source_review.observed: Session/context separation, no timed expiry, native MSG continuation guard and main-loop cleanup. CAS/sentinel acquisition and presence changes are not mapped by this proof.

Service snapshots lifecycle epoch, clears context, initializes transports, then CAS acknowledges only the unchanged epoch. New tests exercise the Rust architectural counterpart; no new C in-cleanup IRQ execution is claimed.

rust_cleanup_irq.scope: One-shot interrupt after every reached Memory::wipe in a real serialized USB service with a live Core/Provider borrow. Bus reset/address/configure or deconfigure/configure; reject valid class input, retain EP0 enumeration, refuse stale readiness, clean newer lifecycle, rearm once, deny old output, revoke PIN and release staging. Not C IRQ execution or every instruction-level/native-erasure interleaving.
